{{Quote|Talsa-Ko is a Mystic. Soon she will experience a vision of Voss prosperity under Emperor Malgus.|Darth Serevin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Talsa-ko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She sided with the rebellious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Serevin]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]]. When confronted by Imperial/Republic heroes, Talsa-Ko stated that she had foreseen that she would side with the victor, so Serevin dueled his enemies to prove the [[New Empire]] worthy of allying with the Voss, only to be killed instead. Left at the strike team's mercy, Talsa-Ko pleaded for both herself and Malgus' remaining ground forces to be spared in exchange for joining their side.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talsa-Ko is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game. She appears during the flashpoint "The Battle of Ilum".<ref name="TOR" />

When players defeat Darth Serevin, they can choose to either execute Talsa-Ko for dark side points or spare her for light side points.<ref name="TOR" />
